title: Inclusive
slide_intent: Show how collective language and images of shared participation can invite someone into a story.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can show inclusion in the relationships visible in its imagery and in the pronouns its writers choose.
demonstration: A group poses with arms around each other and fists raised. The copy connects a community-based movement to collective language and representative imagery.
practical_value: Choose pronouns and a photograph that place the people in the story within a shared community.
